svg.title: Country profiles, model updates, signed survey gaps, and declared measurement weights
svg.text: Sample coverage → regional and signed changes → measurement weights

g.text: A Where are the sampled countries?
64 countries across eight descriptive cultural-region labels
Sample locations; region keys in B.
B What changed in eight regions?
bar = 95% CI; open = spans 0 or n < 5
C Which views differ from the survey?
Zero = survey; left less, right more of named view
D Does emphasis change the audit?
Three two-question bundles · weights sum to one
